messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square for maximizing the minimum triangle area has a largest achievable minimum area of exactly 1/72, attained by placing points at all 12 intersections of a 3-by-3 grid of lines with spacing 1/4 (i.e., at coordinates (i/4, j/4) for i,j in {0,1,2,3}) plus one additional point at the center (1/2, 1/2). This configuration forces the smallest triangle to be a right triangle with legs of length 1/4 along two grid lines, giving area 1/32, and no other triangle in this arrangement is smaller. Any perturbation or alternative placement of 13 points necessarily creates some triangle with area strictly less than 1/32, making this bound tight and optimal."}
